note: Triennial election of the rural district council (nine divisions, two councillors each), polled 31 May 1911: contests in Camly, Lisleitrim, Lower Creggan and Newtownhamilton. Cullyhanna is not filed: three were nominated (James Donaghy, Patrick Green, Peter O'Hanlon) and there was no poll, but the withdrawal was not found. No party labels are printed. Polled 31 May 1911; counted at the Courthouse, Newtownhamilton (deputy returning officers Bernard Coyle and W. H. Starr). Two seats; the elected are printed in capitals and the old members marked with an asterisk.
